entry.description: The simulation module, relative to the project. Defaults to sim/index.ts.

count.description: How many seeds, from `from` up. Defaults to 1000.

params.description: Passed to generate and evaluate as their second argument, e.g. a board size or a difficulty setting.

difficulty.description: The metric to bucket seeds by. Defaults to a metric named difficulty, else the first metric by name.

timeoutMs.description: How long one seed may take before it is reported as timed out. Defaults to 5000.
